Context engine for an LLM agent

Everant AI · Mar 2026 – May 2026 · third team member

What I built

I designed and shipped the context engine powering Everant AI's LLM agent. I joined the Greylock-backed company as its third team member.

The engineering problem: keep prior information available to the agent within a finite context budget.

Scope

  • Memory — retain information across interactions.
  • Retrieval — bring relevant prior information into context.
  • Compression — reduce the context carried forward.
  • Structured state — represent agent state outside the conversation transcript.

Implementation details and benchmark results are not published here.
